title: Sparkly slice of pizza
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='crust' cx='30%' cy='30%' r='80%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe08a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8a94a'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cheese' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe94d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f5b81f'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- pizza slice: tip pointing down-left, crust at upper right -->
  <path d='M30 82 L82 26 A34 34 0 0 0 30 82 Z' fill='url(#cheese)'/>

  <!-- crust band along the top arc -->
  <path d='M82 26 A34 34 0 0 0 52 20 L60 30 A26 26 0 0 1 74 34 Z' fill='url(#crust)'/>
  <path d='M52 20 A34 34 0 0 0 30 34 L40 40 A26 26 0 0 1 60 30 Z' fill='#f0b95c'/>

  <circle cx='62' cy='44' r='7' fill='#e23b2e'/>

  <circle cx='47' cy='56' r='6.5' fill='#e23b2e'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='55' r='2' fill='#ff7a6b'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='58' r='6' fill='#d3352a'/>
  <circle cx='66.5' cy='57' r='1.8' fill='#ff7a6b'/>

  <!-- small basil leaves -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='44' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#3fbf6a' transform='rotate(-40 40 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='66' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#2fa857' transform='rotate(20 56 66)'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff6c0'>
    <path d='M20 22 L22.5 28 L28.5 30.5 L22.5 33 L20 39 L17.5 33 L11.5 30.5 L17.5 28 Z'/>

    <path d='M40 8 L41.3 11 L44.3 12.3 L41.3 13.6 L40 16.6 L38.7 13.6 L35.7 12.3 L38.7 11 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffd95e'>
    <circle cx='26' cy='16' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='92' cy='36' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='8' cy='40' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='80' r='1.8'/>
